1.title: Ex-F.B.I. Agents Crucial to ‘Grand Conspiracy’ Case Suggest Testimony Won’t Help
1.summary: Lawyers for the agents said that their clients would testify about “a properly predicated allegation that then-citizen Trump had unlawfully retained hundreds of highly classified documents.”

2.title: Kitty Lunn, Who Expanded the Boundaries of Dance, Dies at 76
2.summary: After breaking her back in a fall, she helped start Infinity Dance Theater, and found that her wheelchair was a tool, not a hindrance.

3.title: Republicans in Red-State Races Are Starting to Break From Trump
3.summary: Our national political correspondent, Shane Goldmacher, explains how a growing number of Republican candidates in key battleground states are making calculated decisions to distance themselves from President Trump and his policies.

4.title: U.N. Live Updates: Netanyahu Lashes Out at Critics and Underscores Threats to Israel
4.summary: In a combative speech, the prime minister defended Israeli military action across the Middle East, and attacked Mayor Zohran Mamdani of New York. Dozens of delegates walked out of the hall as he took the podium.

5.title: Haiti Turns to Roger Stone To Lobby Trump Administration
5.summary: The Haitian government hired Mr. Stone, a confidant of President Trump, weeks after hundreds of thousands of Haitians lost deportation protection. The contract is worth nearly $800,000, a document shows.

6.title: Netanyahu defends Israeli military action as delegates walk out before UN speech
6.summary: The Israeli leader labels those who left his speech at the UN General Assembly as "moral cowards".
